title: Happy red panda
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='11' fill='#c94b2a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='11' fill='#c94b2a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='6' fill='#f2a07a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='6' fill='#f2a07a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#e86b3a'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#fff4e8'/>
  <!-- white brow patches -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='42' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#fff4e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='42' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#fff4e8'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='48' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#8c3b22'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='48' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#8c3b22'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='3.2' fill='#2b1a12'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='3.2' fill='#2b1a12'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='47' r='1.1' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='47' r='1.1' fill='#fff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#4a2418'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M43 62 Q50 69 57 62' stroke='#4a2418' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='57' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f7a08a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='57' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f7a08a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- chest / body -->
  <path d='M32 75 Q50 68 68 75 Q70 90 50 92 Q30 90 32 75 Z' fill='#e86b3a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#fff4e8'/>
  <!-- little paws -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='86' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8c3b22'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='86' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8c3b22'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M20 82 Q8 76 12 66' stroke='#c94b2a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M12 66 Q8 60 14 56' stroke='#fff4e8' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
